Janelle (People Ops): @here Quick update - we're launching a 6-month pilot starting May 1: Emergency Childcare Stipend + a small PTO allocation refinement for hybrid employees. Short summary below; full FAQ and form on the intranet link. Please flag questions or concerns.

Diego (Eng): Thanks - is this for parents only or caregivers too?

Janelle (People Ops): Caregivers included. Eligibility notes in the FAQ but tl;dr: full-time employees (US-based for this pilot), >3 months tenure, primary caregiver or emergency caregiver for a dependent under 13 or adult dependent with documented needs. Contractors excluded for pilot.

Priya (Product): How do we request the stipend when we need it?

Ava (People Ops): Request via the HR portal: Benefits -> Emergency Stipend request. You can also email benefits@redwood.com if you hit a portal issue. Approvals routed to your manager + HRBP.

Sam (HRBP): A quick eligibility snippet:
- Max stipend: $300 per qualifying month, up to 3 months per event
- One event per rolling 12 months unless escalated
- Requires manager acknowledgement and receipt submission

Liam (Finance): Budget note: pilot cap is $50k. Finance will review utilization monthly and report to execs. If utilization is higher than expected we'll pause intake and reassess.

Diego (Eng): For the PTO change - what does 'allocation refinement' mean?

Janelle (People Ops): Good Q. We aren't changing total accrual rates. We're clarifying how PTO is recorded for hybrid roles so teams have clearer expectations around on-site vs remote day planning. Practically:
- Accrual per pay period unchanged
- New payroll field: 'Work Pattern' - employees self-report as Hybrid/Remote/On-site which determines how managers see available PTO for on-site coverage planning
- Managers should not deny PTO for routine remote days; this is about scheduling clarity for on-site coverage.

Priya (Product): Will this affect headcount planning or billing for dedicated resources?

Liam (Finance): No impact to headcount; this is an administrative label only for scheduling and reporting.

Diego (Eng): What about carryover? I thought we had a 2-day carryover cap.

Ava (People Ops): For 2026 only we're offering a one-time 5-day carryover extension to help folks who had heavy Q4 shipping. After 2026 we'll revert to the standard policy and revisit in annual policy review.

Diego (Eng): Nice, thanks.

Sam (HRBP): International teams - this pilot primarily covers US employees. We'll be gathering feedback and exploring regional adaptations in H2.

Priya (Product): Any privacy concerns about the 'Work Pattern' field?

Ava (People Ops): It's an internal non-sensitive attribute (no health data). Stored in HRIS with usual access controls. Can't be used for punitive action - it's for planning only and tied to our non-discrimination commitments.

HRBot: Reminder: Live Q&A sessions scheduled next Wed 10:00 AM PT and Thu 4:00 PM PT. Recording will be posted.

Janelle (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Read the FAQ: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/childcare-pilot 2) Join a Q&A if you want details 3) Managers, watch for intake notifications in People Ops queue. We'll collect pilot feedback via a short survey after the first 3 months. :raised_hands: 

Diego (Eng): Appreciated.

Priya (Product): Thank you!

Ava (People Ops): Ping us if you need reasonable accommodations during the pilot.

Janelle (People Ops): Closing thread - will post final policy doc and FAQ to the handbook by EOD.
